subject: Post-call recap: CentraBank private VPC discovery & next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@centrabank.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@centrabank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: CentraBank private VPC discovery & next steps

Hi Olivia / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the next steps we agreed on: 

Summary of pain points / constraints
- Data residency: production data must stay within CentraBank-controlled VPCs in us-east-1 and be accessible only from approved subnets.
- Air-gap requirement: payment-processing systems require an air-gapped instance or tightly restricted egress; will need an isolated deployment option or physical on-prem alternative.
- Networking: egress is via corporate proxy; only allowlist of endpoints is permitted. Outbound connections to vendor APIs must be approved.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 + internal audit evidence, KMS/HSM integration for key management, and 7-year audit log retention.
- Performance: expect low-latency inference for customer-facing flows (p95 < 250ms) and bursty peaks for fraud-detection workloads (est. peak RPS ~120).

What we will deliver by next week
1) Network diagram and a CentraBank checklist for private VPC/on-prem deployment (attached: network-diagram.pdf, centra_connect-MVP-checklist.xlsx).
2) Technical deep-dive with our infra + security engineers to cover firewall rules, proxy allowlist, and KMS options — propose Tue 8 Mar, 11:00 AM ET.
3) Draft mutual action plan (MAP) + scope for a 3-month pilot (Mar–May) and pricing estimate (Marissa will share).
4) Legal questionnaire & sample SOW to be routed to your procurement (Dev will own legal items).

Requested items from CentraBank
- Confirm the subnets/NAT/proxy restrictions and whether there is an existing NAT gateway that can be used for vendor allowlist.
- Confirm which systems require air-gap vs. which can tolerate outbound allowlist.
- Expected monthly token volume and peak RPS estimate for sizing.

Next steps / owners
- Camila (me): coordinate technical deep-dive and MAP.
- Marissa: pricing and pilot commercial terms.
- Dev: legal questionnaire & NDA/contract redlines.
- CentraBank: internal confirmation on networking and air-gap boundaries.

Thanks — attaching the network diagram and checklist for your infra/security team to review. If Tue 8 Mar 11:00 AM ET doesn't work, suggest a 1-hour slot that does and we'll send calendar invite.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
Attachment: network-diagram.pdf (diagram, 1 page)
Attachment: centra_connect-MVP-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 rows)

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@centrabank.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@centrabank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: CentraBank private VPC discovery & next steps

Camila — thanks for the clear recap and for the attachments. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We can open outbound to an allowlist of IPs/hostnames via our corporate proxy, but any vendor-hosted service must be approved by network/security. For payment systems we require an air-gapped or on-prem option.
- The air-gap applies to systems that touch PANs and transaction logs; other non-sensitive flows (e.g., customer support chat) can go through a private VPC with restricted egress.
- We will pull together the subnet/proxy details — reach out to me if you need specific NAT IPs.
- Pilot timeline looks feasible; procurement will need an estimated TCO and a short MAP to move quickly.

We can do Tue 8 Mar 11:00 AM ET for the technical deep-dive. I'll invite our infra lead (Tom) and security SME. Please include folks who can talk about KMS and SSO integration.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
VP, Digital Channels | CentraBank
olivia.barnes@centrabank.com

- Need confirmation on token/month estimate and peak RPS to size GPU pools; without that we'll size conservatively and call out potential upgrade steps.
- Attaching pricing sheet (internal) and a MAP template. I'll draft a MAP that includes: success criteria, pilot scope, data residency & KMS approach, timeline and owners.
